mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NM, ITEM_TY, USE_AT, MIN_QTY, STOCK_QTY, RESERVED_QTY FROM ASSET_ITEM WHERE ITEM_CODE IN #{code} ORDER BY ITEM_CODE FOR UPDATE
SELECT ITEM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS STORED_QTY FROM ASSET_UNIT WHERE ITEM_CODE IN #{code} AND STTUS = 'STORED' GROUP BY ITEM_CODE FOR SHARE

SELECT I.ITEM_CODE , CASE WHEN I.ITEM_TY = 'QTY' THEN I.STOCK_QTY ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_UNIT U WHERE U.ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_CODE AND U.STTUS = 'STORED') - I.RESERVED_QTY END AS AVAIL_QTY FROM ASSET_ITEM I WHERE I.ITEM_CODE IN #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASSET_STOCK_HIST (STOCK_HIST_ID, ITEM_CODE, HIST_TY, CHANGE_QTY, AFTER_QTY, RESN, REQ_NO, PROCESS_ID, PROCESS_PNTTM) VALUES (#{stockHistId}, #{itemCode}, #{histTy}, #{changeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{resn}, #{reqNo}, #{processId}, SYSDATE())
mapper.select:
SELECT H.STOCK_HIST_ID, H.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NM, I.ITEM_TY, H.HIST_TY, H.CHANGE_QTY, H.AFTER_QTY, H.RESN, H.REQ_NO, H.PROCESS_ID, H.PROCESS_PNTTM FROM ASSET_STOCK_HIST H JOIN ASSET_ITEM I ON I.ITEM_CODE = H.ITEM_CODE
ORDER BY H.PROCESS_PNTTM DESC, H.STOCK_HIST_ID DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
